meta.note: Read-only checks and consent-gated fixes. The bot may only run what is listed here. Sign every script, test on pilot machines, and verify service names and commands for your versions before use.

adapter_link_state.desc: Is the network adapter connected (cable detected / Wi-Fi associated)?

ip_config_valid.desc: Did the PC receive a valid IP address (not a 169.254.x.x self-assigned one)?
ip_config_valid.mac: ipconfig getifaddr en0 ; ipconfig getifaddr en1

ping_gateway.desc: Can the PC reach its default gateway (router/switch)?

ping_internet_ip.desc: Can the PC reach an outside IP address? Target is configurable ({{PING_TARGET}}) because some networks block ICMP.

dns_resolve.desc: Can the PC translate a website name into an address?

wifi_signal.desc: Wi-Fi signal strength and connected network name.
wifi_signal.mac: Not scripted: ask the user to read the Wi-Fi menu (or use an MDM-approved method)

vpn_client_status.desc: Is the Cisco Secure Client VPN service running? Verify the exact service/process names for the version you deploy.

time_drift.desc: Is the clock close to the correct time? (Wrong clocks break sign-in and certificates.)
time_drift.mac: Ask user to confirm 'Set time and date automatically' is on; reading it may need admin rights

disk_free.desc: Free space on the system drive.

printer_reachable.desc: Can the PC reach the printer's IP address? Printer IP comes from your printer list.

spooler_status.desc: Is the Windows print service running?

flush_dns.consent: I'd like to clear your computer's saved website-address cache. This is safe and nothing is deleted from your files. OK?
flush_dns.note: Mac needs admin rights, so run only through an approved admin mechanism.

renew_ip.consent: I'd like to renew your network address. Your connection will drop for a few seconds. OK?
renew_ip.mac: Ask the user to toggle Wi-Fi off/on, or use an approved MDM action
renew_ip.note: Will briefly disconnect the user, including from this chat.

restart_adapter.consent: I'd like to restart your network adapter. You will lose connection for a few seconds. OK?
restart_adapter.mac: Ask the user to toggle Wi-Fi off/on
restart_adapter.note: Adapter name comes from the adapter_link_state check.

restart_spooler.consent: I'd like to restart the Windows print service. Waiting print jobs may need to be sent again. OK?

clear_print_queue.consent: I'd like to cancel ALL waiting print jobs on your computer and restart the print service. You'll need to print again. OK?
clear_print_queue.win: Stop-Service Spooler -Force; Remove-Item 'C:\Windows\System32\spool\PRINTERS\*' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Service Spooler
clear_print_queue.note: Cancels jobs only on this computer. Does not touch the printer's own stored jobs.

sync_time.consent: I'd like to re-sync your computer's clock with the company time server. OK?
sync_time.mac: Ask the user to turn on 'Set time and date automatically' in System Settings
sync_time.note: A wrong clock can break VPN and sign-in.

clear_user_temp.consent: I'd like to delete temporary files older than 3 days from your user profile. Your documents are not touched. OK?
clear_user_temp.win: Get-ChildItem $env:TEMP -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object LastWriteTime -lt (Get-Date).AddDays(-3) | Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
clear_user_temp.mac: Not scripted: guide the user through System Settings > General > Storage
clear_user_temp.note: Report how much space was freed.
